societies.name: The Female Man (Whileaway)
societies.society: Whileaway's highly mechanized society with enforced work

scope.period: The society described during Janet's visit, after induction helmets enter industry
exclusions: Other Janet stories silently merged into the novel
An exterminated population counted as nonworking

societies.description:
Whileaway is retained provisionally as a zero variant. Its induction technology lets a single worker direct machinery on a scale formerly requiring thousands. Yet work remains a defining social obligation, with severe enforcement against refusal. The scholarly account treats this as a deliberate tension between productive abundance and a culture organized around work. It also flags conflicting descriptions of incessant toil and a short formal week. The classification preserves that ambiguity rather than declaring every remaining task technically pointless.

Material security is therefore conditional enough to prevent a strong universal-guarantee score. Direct participation by workers suggests dispersed human agency, but the consulted sources do not settle ownership or effective political control, so that coordinate remains open. Useful care and other activity still count as work. A short week cannot supply the nonworking share, and the record excludes Jael's different future. The alternative reading is a partially automated society that still needs its remaining labor.

guarantees.basis: Provision is qualified by severe compulsory-participation enforcement. This assesses conditional security, not a claim that ordinary compliant residents lack goods.

control.basis: Worker-directed cybernetic machinery does not settle ownership or the distribution of binding authority.

nonworking.basis: Conflicting work descriptions and a formal short week do not measure all-resident participation; caregiving is useful work.

evidence.claim: The criticism identifies high productive leverage alongside a work imperative whose economic necessity is disputed.
evidence.locator: Whileaway discussion, especially web text lines 153-155 and 192-204

uncertainties: Zero-variant admission is explicitly interpretive: the criticism offers incompatible readings and does not prove every current job redundant.
Both control and participation remain unresolved. A partial post-work reading is an alternative classification.

review.method: Second pass against the gathered passages, including explicit uncertainty; no independent reviewer

societies.name: Accelerando (Economics 2.0 and the human remnant)
societies.society: Humans and human-derived persons exposed to the autonomous inner-system economic takeover

scope.period: The late singularity around Curator and Elector, during inner-system conversion and its impact on human survivors
scope.population: Active human and human-derived persons subject to the machine economic order; restored persons count only when active
exclusions: Autonomous financial agents counted as ordinary humans
Dead people and passive backups counted as leisure residents
Saturn's local refugee government conflated with the inner-system economy
Early Manfred's patrons treated as a universal welfare system
scope.proxy_basis: Recognized active human-derived persons are included; an agent or stored copy is not automatically another human.

societies.description:
The late inner system runs through superhuman intelligences and autonomous economic entities, with planetary matter absorbed into computational infrastructure. Ordinary human skill no longer secures a viable place in that economy. This is a destructive post-work case: productive power expands while protection for the human remnant collapses. Stross's own commentary stresses that people are destroyed and arbitrarily restored in damaged form. Such restoration supplies no dependable right to a safe life or continued resources.

The strongly negative control score describes effective autonomy from the affected humans. The Vile Offspring include human-derived successors, so this is a functional use of the AI end of the axis, not a claim that ancestry alone determines control. Human politics in Saturn's refuges is a separate local system. Economic obsolescence does not establish that every survivor stops researching, caring or organizing; participation remains unresolved. Death, dormant backups and automated financial agents never inflate a human leisure estimate.

guarantees.basis: The author describes destruction and arbitrary damaged resurrection; the late economy offers the human remnant no reliable security of access.

control.basis: Successor intelligences and autonomous economic entities operate beyond ordinary human control. The negative coordinate is relative to the affected human remnant, including an explicit functional analogy for human-derived successors.

nonworking.basis: Obsolete market skills and loss of assets do not count all useful activity among surviving active persons.

evidence.claim: Human economic obsolescence accompanies autonomous productive expansion rather than guaranteed material security.
evidence.locator: Author's 2013 retrospective; reviews' late-system and Economics 2.0 discussions

uncertainties: A reference-led broad assessment; local Saturnian institutions and later extrasolar settlements are distinct.
The active-person proxy and functional AI-control analogy must remain visible in any later presentation.
No full-novel read or human nonworking census is claimed.

review.method: Second pass against the gathered passages, including explicit uncertainty; no independent reviewer

decisions.reason: A clear scholarly account supports a provisional automation/work-obligation contradiction, with alternative readings retained.
Jael's robot companion and inter-society labor trade do not establish general automatic material provision.
decisions.analysis: Womanland/Manland are separate from Whileaway. Robot intimacy and outsourced human labor cannot supply a society-wide post-work mechanism.

decisions.reason: The autonomous successor economy removes human economic power while denying reliable material security to its human remnant.

review_notes: Continues the user's reference-led faster pass; no full primary read or complex format recovery was attempted.
Whileaway's zero classification remains interpretive and openly disputed, with unresolved coordinates. Its short workweek is never converted into a nonworking percentage.

Accelerando's successor economy is scored relative to the affected human remnant with an active-person proxy and explicit functional AI-control analogy. Human extinction or dormant copies never create leisure citizens.
